new: /* 设置 →「资源包」(playtest #33, local line): the status rows, the import bar and the failure list (ui/packPanel.js). */
.set-pack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .08rem; padding-top: .1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.set-pack__row { display: flex; gap: .12rem; align-items: baseline; font-size: calc(.14 * var(--t)); }
.set-pack__actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .1rem; }
.set-pack__picked { min-width: 0; font-size: calc(.13 * var(--t)); color: var(--text-lo); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.set-pack__bar { height: .08rem; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .35); border: 1px solid var(--line-2); overflow: hidden; }
.set-pack__bar > i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--mint-500); transition: width .2s; }

.set-pack__fails { max-height: 2.4rem; margin: 0; overflow: auto; font-family: var(--font-num); font-size: max(.12rem, 11px); line-height: 1.6; color: var(--red-premium); white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.set-pack__note { min-height: 1.5em; font-size: calc(.14 * var(--t)); line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text-md); }
